title: EVA jobs can run as a dedicated job user; everything it runs ends with the job
goal: With eva.jobUser configured, an EVA job runs as that user (sudo, narrow rule), in a shared folder, from a read-only runtime copy; at the end every process of that user is killed and the table is checked
acceptance: Tests with a stand-in sudo: the job runs through `sudo -n -u <user> sandbox-exec`, its instance lives under the shared folder, and at the end `kill -KILL -1` runs as that user and `ps -U <user>` is checked; a survivor makes the end uncertain
run-tools-03 with a job user runs from a read-only runtime copy (node, src, node_modules, package.json) in the shared folder, refreshed when the revision changes
Without eva.jobUser nothing changes; config validation refuses a user name or folder that is not plain
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: The service user and its permission need the owner's setup on each Mac; a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 from the review of PR #549; owner setup apart. Not a measurement. Re-planned 2026-11-19 with the owner: split into T02 (code), T03 (owner setup) and T04 (live check on NERV-01).
